June, I created the weekday 17:30 "Pod end of day" job, but it probably won't post reliably yet. I told you the same in a reply on your message in #strategic-pod.

- **Gateway:** It isn't running, so the job won't fire until someone starts it.
- **Timezone:** The scheduler runs on UTC, so 17:30 there is 12:30 Chicago time. The next run is listed as 2026-10-23, not today.
- **Job output:** The job is saved with local-only delivery, and its prompt tells it to post the note into #strategic-pod itself. I haven't tested that posting step.

Until the gateway and timezone are fixed, today's 17:30 note isn't guaranteed. Ping me at the end of the day and I'll post it by hand.
